title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish from the heart of Arabia, perfect for a weekend dinner. Marinate chicken in a warm blend of spices and grill to perfection.

ingredients.name: Warm spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: Sahlab
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together warm spice blend, sahlab, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with pita bread and garnish with parsley.
